causal_question: Can frozen natural-language semantic states recover the relation/role/operation/control operator required by the proven frozen T1 executor when structural support and focus binding remain oracle?
frozen_inputs_and_modules: oracle focus-field binding for the first T2 causal study

operator_outputs.relation_sequence: ordered one-or-more relation-anchor predictions; v0.1 fixture may instantiate length 1/2 but this is not a permanent hop or operator ceiling
operator_outputs.requested_argument_role: SOURCE/TARGET/SYMMETRIC/NONE seed role bank; migratable, not a permanent role ontology
operator_outputs.operation: current T1 operation seed bank; migratable
operator_outputs.control_applicability: FALLBACK/RELATIONAL/DEFER or equivalent calibrated applicability state
operator_outputs.continuous_residual: continuous operator state retained alongside anchor predictions
operator_outputs.uncertainty_plurality: must remain inspectable and may not be forced to a single confident class when evidence is underdetermined

architecture_requirements: Consume the frozen semantic hidden-state stack rather than only a final pooled vector.
Use query/operator-dependent token and layer evidence; do not hard-code one universal semantic layer.
Previous relation-layer audit results may seed soft priors only; they may not become hard permanent masks.
Do not take oracle relation id as an input to the learned operator encoder.
Do not use graph support selection to solve T2; support remains oracle.
Do not reintroduce parent global field logits or scalar residual competition.
Keep relation and argument role first-class and separately probeable.
Preserve ordered relation sequences for path operations.
Expose per-head token/layer diagnostics so a T2 failure can localize relation, role, operation, or applicability semantics.
No current relation/role/sequence/context/model width is a permanent product ceiling.

causal_evaluation.principle: T2 passes only if predicted operators preserve the T1 causal behavior through the frozen executor, not merely if individual operator labels look plausible.

must_cover: fallback versus defer versus relational applicability
shortcut_controls: No literal relation token may be required for success.
No fixed sentence position may identify relation/role/operation.
No family may map to one invariant target field position.
DEV query templates and lexical pools must be unseen from TRAIN.
Graph/field order must not reveal operator labels.

anti_loop_rule: If T2 later fails, localize operator semantics by relation/role/operation/control and downstream causal-pair metrics. Do not rerun, increase steps, change LR, unfreeze support, or redesign the executor without a new causal diagnosis.
full_eipm_scope_rule: T2 is one causal construction stage of a full-production N0 foundation. Passing T2 does not define the final relation vocabulary, context size, model size, or personality capability envelope.
